task: Determine whether erroneous bona fide utterances in existing EBM embeddings concentrate along particular tangent residual directions
protected: No current training source, process, snapshot, checkpoint, queue or server is read-modified or controlled. Existing local caches are read only; outputs use a new folder. Q embeddings remain unopened.
fit: Centered covariance of uncentered tangent residuals from all 2580 T bona fide embeddings, using archived learned OC centroid; no target-fitted primary basis
error_rule: Accept bona fide iff recomputed native cosine >= threshold; threshold selected once on V by minimum absolute FPR-FNR, tie lower FPR then higher threshold. Q/target labels not used to choose threshold, subspace, k or cutoffs.
supporting_analysis: DF official eval = disjoint pilot + remaining; overlapping with pilots and not independent replication
metrics: Bona fide rejection counts under fixed V threshold
DTRS parallel residual energy and scale-independent parallel energy ratio rho
rho difference error minus accepted, unadjusted and stratified by duration x source x codec
Direction mean resultant length and uncentered second-moment effective rank; equal-sample-size descriptive comparison
Normal score deciles, duration groups and negative-score subgroup
Individual Train residual PCs, sensitivity only; no target-directed axis selection
matching: Error-weighted within-cell difference on common support, requiring >=1 error and >=2 accepted. Also report stricter speaker x duration x source x codec common support. Coverage and sparse groups disclosed.
checks: SHA of every consumed cache array/score/row/centroid file matches catalog before and after
Same checkpoint and centroid across datasets
UID uniqueness, shard order and label counts
Independent energy via explicit projector on sample
No raw-norm claim as directional evidence
No causal or DTRS efficacy conclusion from fixed embeddings
deliverable: Inline findings with scientific figure, inspectable derived CSV/JSON, reproducible CPU analysis script and concise local evidence notes
cleanup: Foreground bounded local process exits on completion; no paid or remote resources, background watchers, new inference or model optimization.
